description: Template management tools for Adobe InDesign. Create, edit, clone, and manage InDesign templates (.indt files) for consistent document production. Templates enable rapid document creation with pre-defined layouts, styles, master pages, and placeholder content.

tools.name: indesign_create_template
tools.description:
Create a new InDesign template file (.indt) from scratch or from an existing document.

Templates are reusable InDesign files that define:
- Page layouts and master pages
- Paragraph and character styles
- Color swatches and style libraries
- Placeholder text and image frames
- Grid and margin settings

Use this tool when:
- User wants to create a reusable document template
- User needs to standardize document production
- User wants to save current document as template
- User is building a brand style guide

Common scenarios:
1. 'Create a business card template' → 3.5x2 inch template with logo placement
2. 'Make a brochure template' → Tri-fold layout with master pages
3. 'Save this document as a template' → Convert .indd to .indt
4. 'Create catalog template for data merge' → Template with <<placeholders>>

Important notes:
- Templates save as .indt files (InDesign Template format)
- Include placeholder fields using <<FieldName>> syntax for data merge
- Master pages define consistent headers/footers/layouts
- Styles cascade to documents created from template
- Lock elements you don't want users to modify

Best practices:
- Use descriptive placeholder names (<<ProductName>>, not <<Field1>>)
- Create multiple master pages for different sections
- Include comprehensive paragraph/character style library
- Document template usage in a separate guide
- Version templates (template_v1, template_v2) for tracking

page_size.description: Page dimensions. Common presets: Letter (8.5x11in), A4 (210x297mm), Tabloid (11x17in)

page_count.description: Initial number of pages (can be expanded when using template)

facing_pages.description: True for spreads (left/right pages), false for single pages

master_pages.description: Master pages to create (page templates for consistent layouts)

position.description: Frame position {x, y, width, height} in points

placeholders.description: Data merge placeholders to include in template

styles.description: Style definitions to include in template

output_path.description: Full path where template will be saved (e.g., 'C:/Templates/catalog.indt')

when_to_use: User wants to create a reusable document template
User needs standardized layouts for production work
User is building brand templates for consistent output
User wants to enable data merge with placeholders
User needs templates for team/client distribution
workflow: Step 1: Design template structure (page size, count, master pages)
Step 3: Store template_id for later reference
Step 4: Optionally call indesign_add_template_content() to populate
Step 6: Distribute to users or save in template library
best_practices: Use clear placeholder names that describe content (<<ProductName>>, not <<Text1>>)
Create master pages for consistent headers/footers across documents
Include comprehensive style library (paragraph, character, object styles)
Lock elements that shouldn't be modified (logos, brand elements)
Document placeholder fields in separate guide for users
Test template with sample data before distribution
error_handling: Error 'Invalid page size' → Use units (8.5in, 210mm, not just numbers)
Error 'Master page name conflict' → Use unique names per master page
Error 'Placeholder already exists' → Check for duplicate placeholder names
Error 'Path not accessible' → Verify output_path folder exists
Error 'Template locked' → Another user has template open

typical_use_cases: Creating product catalog templates for data merge workflows
Building brand style guide templates for team consistency
Designing business card templates for print shop automation
Creating brochure templates for marketing material production

conversation_memory_hints.what_to_remember: Template name, placeholder fields, page structure, intended use case
conversation_memory_hints.search_context: When user asks about past template projects or reusable designs

tools.name: indesign_list_templates
tools.description:
List all available InDesign templates in specified folder or template library.

Retrieves template files (.indt) with metadata including:
- Template name and file path
- Page count and dimensions
- Creation and modification dates
- Placeholder fields (for data merge)
- Master page names
- Style counts (paragraph, character, object)

Use this tool when:
- User wants to see available templates
- User needs to find a specific template
- User is browsing template library
- User wants to know template capabilities before using

Common scenarios:
1. 'Show me all templates' → List all .indt files
2. 'Find catalog templates' → Filter by name/keyword
3. 'What templates have product placeholders?' → Search by placeholder fields
4. 'Which templates were updated this month?' → Filter by date

Useful for template discovery before document creation.

folder_path.description: Path to folder containing templates. If omitted, searches default template library.

has_placeholders.description: Only templates with data merge placeholders

include_metadata.description: Include detailed metadata (placeholders, master pages, styles)

examples.description: List all templates in default library

when_to_use: User wants to browse available templates before creating document
User needs to find specific template by name or features
User wants to see what placeholders a template contains
User is auditing template library for organization
workflow: Step 1: Call indesign_list_templates() with optional filters
Step 3: Select template_name or file_path for next operation
best_practices: Use filters to narrow large template libraries
Check placeholders to ensure template matches data source
Review page_size to confirm it matches print requirements
Check modified_date to find most current templates
error_handling: Error 'Folder not found' → Verify folder_path exists
Error 'No templates found' → Check file_pattern or remove filters
Error 'Permission denied' → Verify read access to template folder
related_tools: indesign_create_document_from_template - Use template after finding it
indesign_get_template_details - Get full details on specific template
indesign_search_templates - More advanced search with keywords

behavioral: User selects template for document creation

typical_use_cases: Browsing template library before starting project
Finding templates with specific placeholders for data merge

tools.name: indesign_clone_template
tools.description:
Duplicate an existing InDesign template to create a variation.

Creates exact copy of template with option to:
- Rename the clone
- Modify placeholders
- Adjust page count
- Update styles
- Change master pages

Use this when:
- User wants to create template variation
- User needs similar template with small changes
- User wants to preserve original while experimenting
- User is creating template version series

Faster than creating template from scratch when starting from existing design.

source_template.description: Path to template to clone (.indt file)

modifications.description: Optional modifications to apply during cloning

examples.description: Clone catalog template with new name

when_to_use: User wants template variation without recreating from scratch
User needs to preserve original while making changes
User is creating seasonal template versions
User wants to experiment with template modifications
workflow: Step 1: Call indesign_list_templates() to find source template
Step 2: Call indesign_clone_template() with source path and new name
Step 3: Optionally modify clone with indesign_update_template()
best_practices: Use descriptive names that indicate variation (template_summer, template_v2)
Document changes between versions in template metadata
Keep original template unmodified as baseline
error_handling: Error 'Source template not found' → Verify source_template path
Error 'Template name conflict' → Choose different new_template_name
Error 'Template locked' → Source template is open, close it first

tools.name: indesign_get_template_details
tools.description:
Retrieve comprehensive details about a specific InDesign template.

Returns template metadata including:
- Page structure (count, size, orientation)
- Master pages (names, applied pages)
- Placeholders and data merge fields
- Paragraph and character styles
- Color swatches and libraries
- Image and text frame counts
- Creation and modification dates
- Template version and author info

Use this tool when:
- User wants to inspect template before using
- User needs to verify placeholder fields match data
- User is reviewing template structure
- User wants to document template capabilities

Common scenarios:
1. 'What fields are in the catalog template?' → List placeholders
2. 'Show me template structure' → Complete metadata
3. 'Does template have product image placeholder?' → Check fields
4. 'What styles are in this template?' → List paragraph/character styles

template_id.description: Template identifier or path to .indt file

examples.description: Get template details with all metadata

when_to_use: Verifying placeholder fields match data source
workflow: Step 1: Call indesign_list_templates() to find available templates
Step 2: Call indesign_get_template_details() for specific template
Step 3: Review placeholders to match with data source
best_practices: Always check template details before data merge
Verify placeholder names match data column names exactly
Review styles to ensure they match branding requirements
Check page count for appropriate template selection
error_handling: Error 'Template not found' → Verify template_id path
Error 'Template corrupted' → Template file damaged, use backup
Error 'Permission denied' → Check file access permissions

tools.name: indesign_update_template
tools.description:
Modify existing InDesign template properties and structure.

Update template elements:
- Add or remove placeholders
- Modify master pages
- Update paragraph/character styles
- Change page dimensions
- Add or remove color swatches
- Update template metadata

Use when:
- Template needs modification
- Adding new placeholder fields
- Updating brand styles
- Changing page structure

Preserves template integrity while applying changes.

workflow: Step 1: Call indesign_get_template_details() to see current state
Step 2: Prepare updates object with changes
error_handling: Error 'Template locked' → Close template in InDesign
Error 'Invalid update' → Check update structure
Error 'Placeholder conflict' → Name already exists
related_tools: indesign_version_template - Create version for major changes

tools.name: indesign_delete_template
tools.description:
Remove InDesign template from template library.

Deletes template file with options to:
- Archive before deletion
- Remove associated files
- Check for active usage
- Confirm deletion safety

Use when:
- Template no longer needed
- Cleaning up template library
- Removing deprecated templates
- Managing storage space

Safety checks prevent accidental deletion of active templates.

workflow: Step 1: Call indesign_template_usage_report() to check if template is used
Step 2: Archive template if still needed
best_practices: Always archive before deletion unless force=true
Inform team before deleting shared templates
error_handling: Error 'Template in use' → Wait or use force=true
Error 'Permission denied' → Check file permissions
Error 'Template not found' → Already deleted or wrong path
related_tools: indesign_import_template - Restore from archive if needed

tools.name: indesign_validate_template_structure
tools.description:
Validate InDesign template integrity and structure.

Checks template for:
- Missing linked files
- Invalid placeholder syntax
- Broken master page references
- Style conflicts
- Font availability
- Color profile issues
- Data merge field errors

Use when:
- Before distributing template
- After template modifications
- Troubleshooting template issues
- Quality assurance workflow

Returns detailed validation report with errors and warnings.

workflow: Step 2: Review errors array for critical issues
Step 4: Re-validate until errors array is empty
best_practices: Fix all errors before using in production
error_handling: Error 'Template corrupted' → Restore from backup
Missing fonts → Install fonts or replace with alternatives
Missing links → Re-link images or update paths
Invalid placeholders → Fix syntax (<<FieldName>>)
related_tools: indesign_update_template - Fix errors found during validation
indesign_export_template - Create clean export after fixes

tools.name: indesign_define_template_variables
tools.description:
Define and manage data merge placeholder variables in template.

Configure placeholders:
- Add text placeholders (<<FieldName>>)
- Add image placeholders (<<@ImageField>>)
- Set default values
- Define field types and validation
- Map to data source columns
- Set placeholder formatting

Use when:
- Setting up template for data merge
- Defining placeholder fields
- Mapping data source to template
- Creating dynamic templates

Essential for automated document generation workflows.

when_to_use: Setting up template for data merge
Defining placeholder fields for dynamic content
Creating catalog or mail merge templates
Mapping data source columns to template
workflow: Step 1: Analyze data source structure (CSV, JSON)
Step 2: Define variables matching data columns
best_practices: Use descriptive variable names (ProductName, not Field1)
Provide default values for optional fields
Match variable names exactly to data column names
error_handling: Error 'Variable name conflict' → Name already exists
Error 'Invalid variable type' → Use text, image, number, or date
Error 'Reserved name' → Avoid InDesign reserved words

tools.description:
Create versioned copy of template for change tracking.

Versioning features:
- Automatic version numbering
- Change documentation
- Version comparison support
- Rollback capability
- Version history tracking

Use when:

- Creating seasonal variations
- Tracking template evolution

Versioned templates enable safe experimentation and change history.

parameters.version_note: Added SKU field and updated brand colors

workflow: Step 2: Work on new version with indesign_update_template()
Step 4: Use indesign_compare_templates() to see differences

tools.name: indesign_compare_templates
tools.description:
Compare two template versions to identify differences.

Comparison detects:
- Added/removed placeholders
- Style changes
- Master page modifications
- Page structure changes
- Color swatch differences

Use when:
- Reviewing template changes
- Auditing template variations
- Deciding which version to use
- Documenting template evolution

Returns detailed diff report with all changes.

workflow: Step 1: Have two template versions to compare
Step 4: Choose appropriate version or merge changes
best_practices: Test both versions if differences are major
Use comparison to inform rollback decisions
error_handling: Error 'Template not found' → Verify both paths
Error 'Incompatible versions' → Templates too different to compare
Error 'Comparison timeout' → Templates too large

IDML export ensures cross-version compatibility.

examples.description: Export template as IDML for compatibility

error_handling: Error 'Export failed' → Check disk space
Error 'Missing fonts' → Set include_fonts=true
